MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB memory card pair fits my repeated purchases of smaller cards, adapters and storage cases; I can see a practical use for spares in compatible devices.",
    "The HDMI cable and Fire TV Stick fit my TV-related purchases: connecting equipment and adding streaming feel like useful next steps, though my listed TV does not need 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and displays assume I want voice assistance or another screen, but my tablet and accessory purchases do not show a current need for either.",
    "The monitoring camera serves a different purpose from my tripods, lens cap and memory cards; buying camera accessories does not mean I need home monitoring.",
    "The 256GB card is relevant to my interest in storage, but I would need to confirm compatibility and a reason for that much capacity before choosing it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a whole range of Alexa devices, when I mainly bought accessories to support the tablet.",
    "My car mounts and cables seem to have been treated as interest in any car electronics, although those purchases addressed specific mounting and connection needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories for devices I already use, so a clear connection to an existing device matters more to me than a broadly related gadget.",
    "My storage purchases have mostly been smaller-capacity cards; capacity and compatibility matter more than higher specifications alone.",
    "Two colors of the same smart speaker do not meet different needs for me; neither gives me a reason to start using a voice assistant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly understood my storage and TV needs but stretched my device purchases into an interest in smart assistants and monitoring."
}
